Definition: Goshen, the residence of the Israelites in Egypt; also a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Goshen = "drawing near"; 1) a region in northern Egypt, east of the lower Nile, where the children of Israel lived from the time of Joseph to the time of Moses; 2) a district in southern Palestine between Gaza and Gibeon; 3) a town in the mountains of Judah probably in the district of Goshen
